source.purpose: P11 draft candidate harvested from the remaining official HarmonyOS-Examples reserve after the regular Phase06 checkpoint reached 47/47 live passed.

entries.usage_goal: Add a self-contained OPDS landing page that keeps inline style extensions, credential toggle state, AppStorage handoff, and Router push flow inside one controller-owned page shell.
blocking_constraints: Keep inline style/password helpers, AppStorage writes, verify toggle state, and Router.push flow source-backed inside the page boundary; do not fabricate auth helpers or detached style layers.

entries.usage_goal: Add a self-contained particle emission page that keeps canvas animation state, inspector-derived coordinates, and TextTimer-driven particle updates inside one controller-owned page shell.
blocking_constraints: Keep CanvasRenderingContext2D ownership, getInspectorByKey usage, particle update loop, and TextTimer callbacks source-backed inside the page boundary; do not introduce detached animation services.

entries.usage_goal: Add a self-contained date-selection home page that keeps Router param hydration, TabsController ownership, and same-file booking builders inside one controller-owned page shell.
blocking_constraints: Keep Router.getParamsObject hydration, start/end date state, tab controller ownership, and builder-defined booking sections source-backed inside the page shell; do not extract booking coordinators or calendar adapters.
